- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:715-726 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The deadline check records a time-budget fallback before the token-budget check, so simultaneous exhaustion can produce misleading fallback telemetry and skip accounting.
  WHY: The run may be reported as falling back to time budget even though the token-budget check stops processing; qwen_qwen3_7-plus and z-ai_glm-5_2 assess runtime behavior as correct and the inconsistency as NIT-level.
- scripts/claude_read_isolated_run.sh:89-94 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Docker image build runs for every single read-profile Claude run.
  WHY: Re-downloading, reinstalling Node packages, and rebuilding the container image on every execution causes substantial unnecessary network overhead, increased latency, and wasted computational resources.
- scripts/claude_read_isolated_run.sh line 2: "# Credential-free read-profile Claude runner; called only by ai_engine.sh." | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The standalone runner is described as called only by ai_engine.sh, but production isolation runs through ai_engine.sh's inline implementation and does not invoke the standalone script.
  WHY: Changes to the standalone script would not affect production behavior, and wiring it in as a replacement would impose substantially lower snapshot limits.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:715-718 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new deadline check can set `claude_fallback_reason` to `"time_budget"` before the token-budget check fires when both budgets are exhausted.
  WHY: Operators may see a time-budget reason even though the token-budget check stops the run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new deadline check records `claude_fallback_reason=time_budget` before checking whether the token budget is exhausted.
  WHY: If both budgets are exhausted at the start of an iteration, the loop reports a time-budget fallback even though the later token-budget check stops processing; with an OpenRouter summarizer, it also says remaining runs will use OpenRouter when they will not, and without one, the earlier no-engine check counts the runs as `skipped_no_engine` instead of `skipped_budget_exhausted`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py lines 717 and 727 | severity=low
  PROBLEM: When both the time budget and token budget are exhausted, the code records `claude_fallback_reason = "time_budget"` and then breaks due to token budget exhaustion.
  WHY: This creates a slight telemetry inconsistency where the fallback reason says "time_budget" but the skip counter says "budget_exhausted"; runtime behavior is correct and this is a NIT-level observation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/claude_read_isolated_run.sh line 2: "# Credential-free read-profile Claude runner; called only by ai_engine.sh." | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone script is staged but never invoked by production code; read-profile isolation runs through ai_engine.sh's inline function.
  WHY: A future developer modifying the standalone script expecting production behavior changes would see no effect, and wiring it as a replacement would impose snapshot limits 10x and 16x lower than the inline implementation.
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py line 763 | severity=low
  PROBLEM: The explicit deadline guard described in the last_run_diff is absent, but the existing guard at line 763 is stricter and catches the expired-deadline condition.
  WHY: The only loss is a diagnostic message distinction ("too short to start this summary" vs "spent during log fetch"); the existing guard makes the new guard redundant.
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py line 715 and line 727 | severity=low
  PROBLEM: When both limits are exhausted, the fallback reason is `"time_budget"` rather than token-budget-related.
  WHY: This is existing behavior not modified by the last_run_diff, and either reason is valid when both limits are exhausted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
